backflip.title: Backflip
backflip.description: A standing back somersault: jump, tuck, a full turn backwards, land on both feet.
backflip.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 88 trial 1

front_flip.title: Front flip (reversed backflip)
front_flip.description: A forward somersault. No clean front flip exists in the source database, so this is the backflip take played backwards: time-reversed flight is still a valid ballistic flight.
front_flip.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 88 trial 1

front_handspring.title: Front handspring
front_handspring.description: A running forward flip over the hands: the hands touch down briefly, then the feet land.
front_handspring.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 90 trial 11

one_hand_stand.title: Stand on one hand
one_hand_stand.description: Kicks up and holds the whole body on one planted hand for about a second and a half, then comes back to standing.
one_hand_stand.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 89 trial 3

handstand.title: Handstand
handstand.description: A handstand with leg kicks. The robot has shorter arms than the performer, so its head comes down to the floor.
handstand.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 85 trial 5

cartwheel.title: Cartwheel
cartwheel.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 88 trial 7

box_jump_up.title: Jump onto a box
box_jump_up.description: A two-foot standing jump onto a platform about knee to hip high.
box_jump_up.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 88 trial 2

box_jump_down.title: Jump down from a box
box_jump_down.description: Steps off a ledge and lands in a deep squat.
box_jump_down.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 82 trial 4

hurdle.title: Jump a hurdle
hurdle.description: A running jump clearing an obstacle.
hurdle.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 127 trial 25

vertical_jump.title: Vertical jump
vertical_jump.description: A high jump on the spot.
vertical_jump.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 16 trial 3

broad_jump.title: Broad jump
broad_jump.source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database (mocap.cs.cmu.edu), subject 13 trial 11
